title: Cohomology vanishing is detected on a finite standard-open cover
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $M^\bullet$ a complex of $A$-modules, and $f:\{0,\ldots,r-1\}\to A$ a finite family generating the unit ideal. View its cohomology in the derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and localize termwise at each $f_i$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. For any integer $n$, if $H^n(M^\bullet\otimes_A A_{f_i})=0$ for every $i$, then $H^n(M^\bullet)=0$.

source.place: Tag 066D, proof, first paragraph; Algebra, Tag 00EO (1)

proof.text: Exact localization identifies $H^n(M^\bullet\otimes_A A_{f_i})$ with $H^n(M^\bullet)_{f_i}$. Equivalently use the exactness of the localized differential pair and identify termwise extension of scalars with module localization.
Apply the unit-ideal localization zero criterion to each element of $H^n(M^\bullet)$. All its localized images are zero, so it is zero, and the module is a zero object.

theorem homology_vanishes_of_localization_span
    {A : Type u₁} [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A)]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) ℤ)
    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [∀ i : Fin r, HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} (Localization.Away (f i)))]
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤)
    (n : ℤ)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin r,
      IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} (Localization.Away (f i))) n).obj
        (Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex
          (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i))))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M)))) :
    IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) n).obj (Q.obj M))
